description:
A tiered secret store for Java. Reads a credential from the first place that answers, in the
    order environment variable, the operating system's own credential store, then a
    permission-restricted file. Saves to the strongest place that can be written, and a remove
    clears every place a save can reach. Windows, macOS and Linux are bound through
    java.lang.foreign, so there is no runtime dependency beyond the JDK.
